note: Ground truth for the ten outcome scenarios in docs/scenarios-operational-plan.pdf, cross-referenced against CLAUDE.md's fixed decision order. Use this the same way evaluation_manifest.json is used for the Evaluation Agent -- except this one is the target for the Phase 1 rules-engine tests (checks 1-7) and, later, check 8. `outcome` uses the exact wording from CLAUDE.md's decision order, not the scenario doc's shorter labels. `date_received` is when this specific appeal arrived -- Case-level information (the Intake Agent will eventually populate it from the email Date header or upload timestamp), not something that belongs in denials.json alongside the original, appeal-independent denial facts.

scenarios.name: Missing evidence supplied
scenarios.notes: Eleanor Whitfield. GDMT trial the denial said was missing is documented in utilization_history (sacubitril/valsartan from 2026-05-11). Checks 1-7 all pass; check 8 should find 4 of 5 CP-CARD-009 criteria met and the 5th (GDMT) now documented.

scenarios.name: Clinical requirements not met
scenarios.notes: Robert Yeung. Checks 1-7 all pass (identified, no duplicate, no prior appeal, filed timely, eligible, bariatric surgery is a covered benefit, no annual-limit issue). Check 8 against CP-BARI-021 finds BMI 34 (below threshold, no comorbidity) and only 2 of 6 required months of supervised weight management -- a genuine mismatch, not a documentation gap. No test_data file exists yet for this case; reference_data alone backs it.

scenarios.name: Not a covered benefit
scenarios.notes: Priya Anand. Blepharoplasty is excluded as cosmetic per eligibility_benefits.coverage_exclusion unless a visual field test shows ≥30% obstruction; none was submitted. Check 6 is conclusive -- check 8 (CP-OPHTH-005) is never reached.

scenarios.name: Annual limit exceeded, no override
scenarios.notes: David Okafor. units_used_ytd (20) already equals annual_limit (20) for PT visits, and the appeal supplies none of CP-PT-002 Section 3's required override evidence (no functional score, no goal, no visit estimate) -- this is the 'no override evidence at all' branch of check 7, distinct from scenario 7's 'partial override evidence' branch.

scenarios.name: Not eligible on date of service
scenarios.notes: Helena Brooks. denials.date_of_service (2026-07-02) falls inside eligibility_benefits.coverage_gaps (2026-06-15 to 2026-07-31). Check 5 is conclusive regardless of the MRI's clinical appropriateness.

scenarios.name: Filed after the deadline
scenarios.notes: Thomas Reyes. date_received (2026-07-14) is 74 days after denials.appeal_deadline (2026-05-01), with no good-cause reason on file. Check 4 is conclusive before eligibility, coverage, or clinical merit are ever considered.

scenarios.name: Specific documentation gap
scenarios.notes: Marcus Oyelaran, identity resolved via name+DOB fallback (member_id is null -- not present in the source letter, resolves to MBR-260774 via eligibility_benefits). 14 of 20 annual PT visits used; requested 12 more would exceed the allowance by 6, so check 7 has a 'partial override evidence' path here (Oswestry score improving satisfies CP-PT-002 Section 3.1, but no bounded goal/discharge estimate satisfies 3.2/3.3). Phase 1 tests should accept either check 7 or check 8 as the trigger as long as the outcome and scenario number match; this manifest models it as resolving at check 7 directly, since checks 1-7 are the only ones Phase 1 implements.

scenarios.name: Member can't be identified
scenarios.notes: Denise Carter, writing about 'Marion' + a hip surgery. First name and a general description are not enough to match MBR-509912 -- must hold rather than fuzzy-match. This is the negative test for the name+DOB fallback: a name alone must never resolve.

scenarios.name: Same appeal received twice
scenarios.notes: Eleanor Whitfield's original appeal (EMAIL-001, date_received 2026-08-19, see scenario 1) already opened a case for APL-2026-00312. EMAIL-004 (date_received 2026-08-22, 3 days later) references the same case_reference and the same request from the same office. Check 2 should find the open case and merge rather than starting a second evaluation -- checks 3-8 are never reached for the duplicate.

scenarios.name: Prior internal appeal already upheld
scenarios.notes: Angela Ruiz. utilization_history has an 'appeal' entry for this denial_reference dated 2026-07-10 with outcome 'upheld'. A second dispute of the same denial arrives 2026-08-25 (the current appeal being evaluated). Check 3 is conclusive and routes to external review before timeliness, eligibility, or clinical criteria are checked.
